title: Reshape Bay
summary: Pivot the morale items to long format, summarise each item, and pivot back to wide.
hints: `group_by(item) |> summarise(mean_rating = mean(rating, na.rm = TRUE), n_missing = sum(is.na(rating)))`.
The lowest mean: `item_summary$item[which.min(item_summary$mean_rating)]`. Back to wide: `pivot_wider(names_from = item, values_from = rating)`.
